params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: Answering a contact message needs no consent, so the required checkbox should go; the newsletter gets its own optional checkbox, unticked by default.

Today the contact form requires one checkbox that covers both the reply and, "if I opted in", the newsletter, while the form has no way to opt in. Asked: drop the required consent for the reply, and add a checkbox "Send me Gentells This Week. I can unsubscribe at any time.", unticked by default. The privacy text already gives legitimate interest as the basis for answering messages. If this needs a layout change, keep the current form and flag it.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Contact form: no consent box to send a message, a separate unticked box for the newsletter
